import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long capacity;
        long cost;
        int revIdx;

        Edge(int to, long capacity, long cost, int revIdx) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.revIdx = revIdx;
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlowSolver {
        List<List<Edge>> adj;

        MinCostFlowSolver(int n) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long w) {
            int uRev = adj.get(u).size();
            int vRev = adj.get(v).size();
            adj.get(u).add(new Edge(v, cap, w, vRev));
            adj.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, -w, uRev));
        }

        long compute(int s, int t, long flow) {
            long total = 0;
            int n = adj.size();
            long[] dist = new long[n];
            long[] potential = new long[n];
            int[] parent = new int[n];
            int[] parentEdge = new int[n];
            final long INF = (long)1e18;

            while (flow > 0) {
                Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
                dist[s] = 0;
                PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
                while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                    long[] top = pq.poll();
                    long d = top[0];
                    int u = (int) top[1];
                    if (dist[u] < d) continue;
                    for (int i = 0; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                        Edge e = adj.get(u).get(i);
                        if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to]) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost + potential[u] - potential[e.to];
                            parent[e.to] = u;
                            parentEdge[e.to] = i;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{dist[e.to], e.to});
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (dist[t] == INF) return -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    potential[i] += dist[i];
                }
                long flowNow = flow;
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    flowNow = Math.min(flowNow, adj.get(parent[v]).get(parentEdge[v]).capacity);
                }
                flow -= flowNow;
                total += flowNow * potential[t];
                for (int v = t; v != s; v = parent[v]) {
                    Edge e = adj.get(parent[v]).get(parentEdge[v]);
                    e.capacity -= flowNow;
                    adj.get(v).get(e.revIdx).capacity += flowNow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long N = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long M = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long K = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long C = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long D = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        int[] A = new int[(int)K];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
        }

        int[] us = new int[(int)M];
        int[] vs = new int[(int)M];
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            us[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            vs[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
        }

        int totalNodes = (int)(N * 101 + 2);
        MinCostFlowSolver mcf = new MinCostFlowSolver(totalNodes);
        int s = (int)(N * 101);
        int t = s + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            mcf.addEdge(s, A[i], 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
            mcf.addEdge(N * i, t, K, C * i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                mcf.addEdge(i * (int)N + j, (i + 1) * (int)N + j, K, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= K; k++) {
                    long cost = (2 * k - 1) * D;
                    mcf.addEdge((int)(i * N + us[j]), (int)((i + 1) * N + vs[j]), 1, cost);
                    mcf.addEdge((int)(i * N + vs[j]), (int)((i + 1) * N + us[j]), 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(mcf.compute(s, t, K));
    }
}
